Polywrap Films is our only qualified supplier of the 23-micron stretch film used on all four pallet wrappers. Qualifying a new supplier takes about four months (trials plus customer sign-off). We use roughly 9 tonnes a month.

state: Incident note, Saturday 24 Oct, 11:30. Brightloom's autumn code FALL15 was meant to give 15% off orders over £60 on full-price home textiles. It went live at 08:00 on the site banner and in an email to 48,000 subscribers. A setup error left out the £60 minimum and let the code stack with the existing 20% clearance discount, so clearance items are going out at 35% off. Since 08:00, 1,140 orders have used FALL15; a normal Saturday morning brings about 400 orders in total. A deal-forum thread titled "Brightloom stacking glitch", posted at 09:50, has 600 replies. On clearance items at 35% off our margin is about -4%; on full-price items at 15% off it is about +28%. 62% of FALL15 orders contain clearance items. Version 5.3 adds the new budgeting screen, which marketing has announced for 2 Nov with a press briefing that morning. The 5.3 build went to app store review on 22 Oct; review normally takes 1 to 3 days, but twice this year it took 6 days. Beta: 420 testers, crash-free sessions 99.1% against a target of at least 99.5%. state: Incident prep note, 22 Nov 2027, 09:30. On 20 Nov at 16:05 an outside researcher emailed security@ to report that our document app's public share links (/s/{token}) still return a file when the last 4 characters of the token are removed, because the lookup uses a prefix match. The researcher attached two sample links that opened other customers' files: a payroll spreadsheet with staff names and salaries, and a signed contract. The email sat unread in the shared inbox over the weekend; the on-call engineer read it at 09:12 today and reproduced the flaw by 09:25. Code history shows the prefix match shipped in release 3.14 on 2 Oct. Access logs since 2 Oct show 1,840 successful requests using shortened tokens, from 23 distinct IP addresses, 2 of which belong to the researcher. A patch that requires an exact token match is written and tested; deploying it takes 15 minutes. Security policy: confirmed exposure of customer personal data is reported to the privacy officer within 24 hours of confirmation, and affected customers are told within 72 hours of confirmation.

state: Duty scientist's note, 07:30, 18 July 2027. Routine overnight samples from Hillcrest service reservoir: total coliforms detected in 2 of 3 samples (target: none detected); E. coli not detected in any sample; chlorine residual 0.08 mg/L (operating minimum 0.2 mg/L). Hillcrest supplies about 6,400 homes and St Anne's Hospital. Yesterday at 15:00 a roof hatch on the reservoir was found unlatched after storm damage; it was secured at 16:10. Customer contacts since midnight: 3 about taste, none about illness. Water safety procedure: (1) if E. coli is found in any sample, issue a boil-water notice at once. (2) If coliforms are found while chlorine is below the operating minimum: raise chlorine dosing; isolate the reservoir if an alternative supply exists; resample within 6 hours; inform the health authority the same day. A boil-water notice then follows only if resampling finds E. coli or the health authority advises one. The procedure says nothing about contacting individual customers. Westfield reservoir can supply Hillcrest's zone for up to 48 hours.

q1.instructions: E. coli was found in at least one sample.

criteria.true: At least one sample contained E. coli.
criteria.false: No sample contained E. coli.

q2.instructions: The hatch incident offers a plausible route for contamination.

criteria.true: An open hatch before sampling could have let contamination in.
criteria.false: The hatch incident does not offer a plausible route for contamination.

q3.instructions: Under the procedure, what should the duty scientist do now?

criteria.Boil-water notice now: Issue a boil-water notice to the zone immediately.
criteria.No action: Wait for the next routine samples.
criteria.Raise chlorine only: Increase dosing and do nothing else.
criteria.Isolate, dose, resample, inform: Switch the zone to Westfield, raise dosing, resample within 6 hours and tell the health authority today.
criteria.Resample only: Take new samples and wait for results.
criteria.Cut all supply: Turn off water to the whole zone.

q4.instructions: How serious is the water quality situation this morning?
criteria: Normal: All results within targets.
Low concern: A single minor result off target.
Elevated: Indicator bacteria with weak disinfection, but no faecal indicator.
High: A faecal indicator found, or illness reported.
Emergency: Confirmed illness outbreak linked to the supply.

q5.instructions: Should the hospital be contacted directly this morning, before resampling results are in?

criteria.Contact now: Tell the hospital about the results and the actions being taken this morning.
criteria.Wait for results: Contact the hospital only if resampling finds a problem.

Note to the permits officer, 22 October 2027.

Application NE-27-044 from Brennick Civil Ltd asks for a noise exemption to resurface Station Road overnight, 23:00 to 05:00, on 4 nights, 8 to 11 November 2027. City noise rule: construction noise is not allowed from 22:00 to 07:00 in residential areas without an exemption. An exemption may be granted only when (a) daytime work would cause serious traffic disruption or a safety risk, and (b) every address within 100 m receives written notice at least 7 full days before work starts (not counting the day the notice is delivered or the first day of work). The officer may attach conditions to an exemption.

Station Road carries about 22,000 vehicles a day and is the main route to the hospital; the transport department supports night work. Brennick plans to deliver letters to 140 addresses on 2 November. Noise forecast at the nearest homes: 78 dB on nights 1 and 2 (milling), 65 dB on nights 3 and 4 (paving).

The residents' association objects, pointing to 3 earlier overnight jobs on the same road this year, and asks for work to stop by 01:00 each night. A care home is 40 m from the works. Brennick has offered hotel rooms to residents of homes within 30 m during the two milling nights.

criteria.grant, stop at 01:00: Grant it but only for 23:00 to 01:00 each night
criteria.defer: Put off a decision until a public meeting has been held

The marketplace measures sellers over the last 90 days: the late shipment rate (late orders divided by all orders) must stay below 4%, and the order defect rate (orders with a buyer claim, a one- or two-star review, or a refund, divided by all orders) must stay below 1%.
